remarks: A splendid long-term rental offered fully furnished, this masterfully reimagined English manor was taken down to the studs and completely rebuilt in 2014. Privately set at the end of a cul-de-sac and perched atop 2.50 acres of manicured lawns, it captures sweeping views of Cos Cob Harbor and Long Island Sound. A state-of-the-art Crestron system provides effortless, whole-house control of lighting, shades, climate, audio/visual, and security. Refined formal rooms, a bespoke gourmet kitchen, and dual terraces open seamlessly to the level grounds. The home also features a finished lower level with playroom and fitness room, a third-floor bonus room, and a fourth-floor tower room with spectacular water views. Private water access completes this exceptional offering.
